newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drachma pierces 310 level, bonds, depos idle.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drachma pierces 310 level, bonds, depos idle.

text.p: The ecu was hanging on to earlier gains against the drachma trading around 310.25/35 in late dealings, interbank depos and forex forwards were little changed and bonds were holding morning price levels, dealers said.
Greek markets will be closed on May Day.

"The drachma has weakened more against the ecu on emerged buying interest for ecus from abroad," said a forex dealer at a foreign bank. "I think players bought about 100 to 120 million ecus for drachmas today pushing ecu/drachma higher."
The central bank sold a token amount of marks and ecus at the fixing to stem the advance of the ecu against the drachma, said forex traders.

But traders offered different explanations of the central bank's move to sell ecus for drachmas at the fixing with some saying it was a signal that ecu/drachma had risen too much and others suggesting that the central bank just wanted an orderly market.

"The market is split among those who believe that the hard drachma policy is still in place and others who believe that the hard drachma policy has been relaxed to say the least," said a forex trader.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said in a report that volatility in ecu/drachma raised doubts about the central bank's commitment to the hard drachma policy that aims to reduce inflation.
Depos and forex forwards were fluctuating in narrow bands, dealers said.
"It is the dollar interest rate component that affects forex forwards," said a dealer at a foreign bank. "The drachma component is just frozen."
Bond dealers said it was a quiet day with prices holding morning levels.
The mark was quoted at 158.85/95 from Wednesday's 158.425 fix, the dollar at 275.55/65 drachmas from 274.400 and the ecu at 310.26/36 from 309.400 drachmas.
